summary: Execute ECMAScript RegExp.prototype.exec with full RegExp matching and result-object semantics.

requirements.receiver_inferred_as: ECMAScript RegExp or runtime RegExp value

target.notes: Builtin exec requires a RegExp internal slot, ToString-coerces input, performs RegExpBuiltinExec, updates lastIndex when g/y apply, and creates JS match arrays.

caveats: Do not replace with Regex.Match: grammar, Unicode/case semantics, lastIndex state, captures, and result shape differ.
If the exec property itself may be overridden, ordinary method-property dispatch must be preserved before choosing this builtin rule.
